title: DOW-UAP-PR115, Unresolved UAP Report, Gulf of America, 2019
what_is_it: A US government video case entry — an 8-second infrared (thermal) video clip of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, released with a short official description.
interpretation_warnings: The case is officially 'Unresolved' — no conclusion has been reached about what the object was.
AARO expressly states the description is not an analytical judgement or factual determination about the event.
The footage is extremely short (8 seconds, of which the last 2 have no content) and single-source.
The object is only an 'area of contrast' partly obscured by the heads-up display; flickering and apparent motion can be sensor or tracking artefacts rather than the object itself.
Infrared sensors only capture a narrow band of wavelengths; when a target's temperature is close to its surroundings it can be hard to characterise (AARO's own comment, truncated in the source).
No underlying PDF text was extractable; findings rest on the released metadata and short official description only.

key_facts.source_quote: aboard a U.S. military platform in 2019

verifiable_claims.claim: The footage is 8 seconds long and was captured by an infrared sensor on a US military platform in 2019.
